message: cannot move `v[_]` out of a borrow or an index: its type is not `Copy`

fix.description: borrow it instead (`&v[_]`), or take the value out and leave another in its place with `mem.replace(&mut v[_], other)` or `mem.swap` (`import std.mem;`)

message: cannot move `*xs[_]` out of a borrow or an index: its type is not `Copy`

fix.description: borrow it instead (`&*xs[_]`), or take the value out and leave another in its place with `mem.replace(&mut *xs[_], other)` or `mem.swap` (`import std.mem;`)
